meta.name: axe01010 Design DNA
meta.description: Extracted from existing GitHub profile README and portfolio-v2 site. Minimalist hacker aesthetic — no fluff, no cloud, phone-as-dev-machine.

primary.role: background — GitHub dark canvas, the void the text floats on

secondary.role: links, interactive accents — the only color that moves

accent.role: secondary text, timestamps, metadata — muted but legible

neutral.usage: bg → card → border → muted text → primary text, 6-step ramp

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast — c9d1d9 on 0d1117, maximum readability for long code sessions

font_families.heading: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
font_families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: System font stack for body — fast, native, no web font load. Mono for code blocks only. No decorative typefaces. Geometric sans implied by system-ui.

spacing.content_density: comfortable — generous line-height 1.6, section gaps at 32px+
spacing.section_rhythm: 24px between sections, 8px between list items, 4px between inline elements

layout.alignment_tendency: strict left-align — code-block centered stack diagram is the only centered element

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px #30363d on cards, none on text

elevation.shadow_style: none — flat markdown, no shadows possible in GitHub README

iconography.style: none — no icons in README, text-only

motion.philosophy: none — the page does not move. it is read, not experienced.

components.button_style: n/a in README — portfolio has plain links as buttons (no fill, no border)
components.card_style: n/a in README — portfolio uses 1px border #30363d, 8px radius, bg #161b22
components.list_style: plain unordered lists, no bullets, no custom markers
components.component_notes: GitHub README is pure markdown — no custom HTML components. Portfolio uses semantic HTML with minimal CSS.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: terminal output — the page reads like a well-commented shell session

visual_language.complexity: minimal — every element earns its place, nothing decorative
visual_language.ornamentation: none — no badges, no emojis, no SVG art, no animated gradients
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous — sections breathe, 24px+ gaps, no cramped layouts
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: top-heavy — tagline + manifesto carry the weight, pinned repos provide scan anchors
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element — the tagline `> phone. termux. real work.` is the only thing that matters
visual_language.contrast_level: high — maximum contrast for readability, no subtle layering
visual_language.texture_usage: none — flat color, no noise, no gradients, no patterns

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy — h2 headers create sections, code block creates visual anchor, bold text creates scan points
composition.balance_type: asymmetric — left-aligned throughout, no centering except the stack diagram
composition.flow_direction: vertical scroll — single axis, no lateral movement
composition.grouping_strategy: section-based — related content grouped under h2 headers, separated by whitespace
composition.negative_space_role: active — whitespace is not empty, it is structure. gaps define sections more than borders do.

imagery.graphic_elements: ASCII stack diagram — the only non-text visual

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: lowercase declarative — sentences without capitalization, periods without ceremony
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: informal but precise — 'i treat it like one' not 'This organization provides'
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative — 'star it', 'prs welcome', 'dm on github'

overview.performance_tier: lightweight — pure markdown, zero JS, zero CSS, renders instantly
overview.fallback_strategy: n/a — there is nothing to fall back from

background_effects.description: flat #0d1117 background, no gradient, no noise, no animation

text_effects.description: plain text only — no split-letter, no typewriter, no glitch

visual_effects.composite_notes: This is a zero-effect design by intent. The entire aesthetic is 'what if the page did nothing.' Visual effects would contradict the brand. The only permitted flourish is the ASCII stack diagram in the README — a single static code-block illustration that explains the tech stack at a glance. Performance is instant (pure markdown, 0KB JS). The anti-effects stance IS the visual identity.
